boundary: Authored possible consequences, no predictions or moral score. Independent human standing, refusal and uncertainty retained. No browser script, storage or assessment added.

image.method: Built-in image generation: daylight edit of the retained original illustration; conceptual artwork, not documentary evidence
image.prompt: Edit this existing workshop illustration into a genuinely LIGHT, hopeful daylight illustration for a warm parchment-themed website. Preserve the workshop, open door, path into the field, both ordinary adults sharing the repair, offered empty chairs, basin, folded linen, notebook, believable anatomy and overall panoramic composition. Transform dusk into a clear late-morning day: abundant soft natural sunlight through the open doorway and rafters, bright creamy plaster/stone at left, pale sky, fresh sage and olive greenery, warm honey-coloured wood and sunlit linen. Lift all deep navy/black shadows into softly shaded cream, sand and muted sage; especially the whole LEFT third should be airy pale warm ivory with unobtrusive texture, suitable for dark-green HTML text over it. Keep the people and workshop detail primarily in the right two-thirds. The lamps can remain as unlit objects. Beautiful high-quality painterly realism with tactile materials, restrained colour, calm hospitality and everyday service. This must feel open, humane and sunlit, with no ominous darkness, night glow or heavy vignette. Preserve its identity as an illustration rather than a documentary photograph. No text, lettering, captions, logos, borders, halos or watermarks.

imagePredecessor.method: Built-in image generation; conceptual illustration, not documentary evidence
imagePredecessor.prompt: Create one high-quality PNG editorial illustration for Aaron Alderman's Questions website page about personally living like Jesus through care, accountable engineering and kenotic service. Panoramic landscape composition, approximately 16:9. Rich painterly realism, extraordinary architectural detail and tactile wood, lamplight and dusk atmosphere, an understated contemporary illuminated workshop opening onto a field. Palette: very deep charcoal navy and indigo shadows, warm amber candle and lamp light, muted sage outdoors, restrained dusty rose. In the RIGHT two-thirds, two ordinary adults of equal standing quietly share a practical repair at a wooden worktable, one making room and offering a chair rather than directing the other. Faces small and unidentifiable, believable anatomy. An open doorway, two empty wooden chairs, a simple clay water basin, folded linen, hand tools and an unlettered notebook suggest hospitality, foot-washing, repair and responsibility. The workshop is human and lived-in, neither grand nor wealthy. A winding path into a softly lit field beyond the open door gives depth and possibility. Keep the LEFT third predominantly spacious deep blue shadow and softly suggested wall/landscape, suitable for a readable text overlay supplied later in HTML. The main illuminated action must remain on the right and should crop gracefully on phones. Beautiful depth and light, quiet moral urgency, service without spectacle. This is a conceptual illustration, not documentary evidence. NO text, lettering, numbers, logos, UI, borders, captions or watermarks. No halos, thrones, religious portrait, fantasy weapons, magical particles, heroic poses, or glowing technological screens.
